reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Unforgiving Monkey (Book V) and its frame; the gold-finder tells it to the wheel-bearer. Every beat is kept: the greedy ram, the chief's chain of reasoning, the fire, the order to kill the monkeys, the lotus-stalk trick, the necklace lure, the attendants lost in the lake.
Every death (horses, monkeys, attendants) is one calm sentence with no added gore; Ryder does not say the ram or the cook dies and neither does the retelling.

Kubera is named only inside the monkey's own lie, never by the narrator; the naming and the dropped frame are disclosed. The narrator never praises the revenge, and a discussion question weighs the attendants' innocence.
Age band 12+: innocent animals and people die. No em dashes; the pause question comes before the reveal.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, under 650 KB; one Codex gpt-5.6-sol generation with seams exactly at x=512 and y=512/1024; no text.
The stable fire is shown only as smoke over a charred thatch roof; no flames, burnt horses or dead monkeys are drawn. Panel 6 shows only folded shawls on the bank, with no bodies.
The water-fiend is a calm green figure with a pearl necklace and faint yellow eyes: eerie, not graphic, for 12+.

Fixed before approval: one edit pass replaced the king's modern black shoes in panel 3 with plain tan mojari; only that panel was composited back. The scene 1 alt text was corrected to match the picture. No caste markers or gods; similar natural skin tones.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children, parents or adult readers.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.
Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels; edited panels were re-checked by a separate agent.
